items.label: interior angle
items.hint: An angle inside a shape, at one of its corners.

items.label: polygon
items.hint: A closed shape with straight sides: triangle (3), quadrilateral (4), pentagon (5), hexagon (6), octagon (8).

items.label: regular polygon
items.hint: All sides and all angles are equal, so each angle is the angle sum shared equally: a regular hexagon has angles of $120^\circ$.

items.label: angle sum of a triangle
items.hint: True for every triangle, whatever its shape or size: tear off the corners and they fill a straight line.

items.label: angle sum of a polygon
items.hint: Split it into triangles from one corner: a shape with $n$ sides makes $n - 2$ triangles. A pentagon: $3 \times 180^\circ = 540^\circ$.
